intents.description: Incantation: Gain 3 Ritual.
Dark Strike: Deal 6 damage.

behavior.description: Always uses Incantation on the first turn, then repeats Dark Strike every turn.

intents.description: Chomp: Deal 11 damage.
Bellow: Gain 3 Strength and 6 Block.
Shield Bash: Deal 7 damage and gain 5 Block.

behavior.description: Always uses Chomp on the first turn. Afterwards, chooses with probabilities: Bellow 45%, Shield Bash 30%, Chomp 25%. Cannot use Bellow or Chomp twice in a row. Cannot use Shield Bash three times in a row.

abilities.description: When HP ≤ 50%, forces next turn's intent to Split (Spike).

intents.description: Corrosive Spit: Deal 16 damage, add 2 Slimed to discard pile.
Lick: Apply 2 Frail.
Split into two Spike Slimes (Medium), each with current HP.

behavior.description: Randomly uses Corrosive Spit or Lick, cannot repeat the same intent three times in a row. When HP ≤ 50%, forces Split on next turn.

intents.description: Corrosive Spit: Deal 8 damage, add 1 Slimed to discard pile.
Lick: Apply 1 Frail.

behavior.description: Randomly uses Corrosive Spit or Lick, cannot repeat the same intent three times in a row.

intents.description: Tackle: Deal 5 damage.

behavior.description: Uses Tackle every turn.

abilities.description: When HP ≤ 50%, forces next turn's intent to Split (Acid).

intents.description: Corrosive Spit: Deal 11 damage, add 2 Slimed to discard pile.
Heavy Strike: Deal 16 damage.
Lick: Apply 2 Weak.
Split into two Acid Slimes (Medium), each with current HP.

behavior.description: Randomly uses Corrosive Spit, Heavy Strike, or Lick. Cannot use Heavy Strike twice in a row; other intents cannot be used three times consecutively. When HP ≤ 50%, forces Split on next turn.

intents.description: Corrosive Spit: Deal 7 damage, add 1 Slimed to discard pile.
Heavy Strike: Deal 10 damage.
Lick: Apply 1 Weak.

behavior.description: Randomly uses Corrosive Spit, Heavy Strike, or Lick. Cannot use Heavy Strike twice in a row; other intents cannot be used three times consecutively.

intents.description: Tackle: Deal 3 damage.
Lick: Apply 1 Weak.

behavior.description: On the first turn, 50% Tackle / 50% Lick. Then alternates between Tackle and Lick.

intents.description: Smash: Deal 4 damage and apply 1 Weak.

behavior.description: Uses Smash every turn.

abilities.description: Angry 1: Upon taking attack damage, gain 1 Strength.

intents.description: Scratch: Deal 4 damage.

behavior.description: Uses Scratch every turn.

intents.description: Protect: Grant 7 Block to a random other enemy.
Shield Bash: Deal 6 damage.

behavior.description: If there are other enemies alive, use Protect (random target, not self). Otherwise, use Shield Bash.

intents.description: Stab: Deal 9 damage.

behavior.description: Uses Stab every turn.

intents.description: Charge: Does nothing.
Ultimate Blast: Deal 25 damage.

behavior.description: Charges for 2 turns, then uses Ultimate Blast. Afterwards, requires 3 turns of charging before using Ultimate Blast again.

abilities.description: Curl Up: The first time it takes attack damage, gain 5-7 Block (determined at combat start). Once per combat.

intents.description: Bite: Deal 5-7 damage (value decided at start of combat).
Grow: Gain 3 Strength.

behavior.description: Randomly uses Bite or Grow; cannot use the same intent three times in a row.

abilities.description: Curl Up: The first time it takes attack damage, gain 5-7 Block (determined at combat start). Once per combat.

intents.description: Bite: Deal 5-7 damage (value decided at start of combat).
Web: Apply 2 Weak.

behavior.description: Randomly uses Bite or Web; cannot use the same intent three times in a row.

intents.description: Stab: Deal 13 damage.
Scrape: Deal 8 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable.
Net: Apply 1 Entangled (cannot play Attack cards this turn).

pattern.description: Has a 25% chance to use Net. When Net is used, next turn is forced to Stab. Otherwise, follows the sequence Scrape → Scrape → Stab.

intents.description: Stab: Deal 12 damage.
Rake: Deal 7 damage and apply 1 Weak.

behavior.description: Each turn randomly chooses between Stab (60%) and Rake (40%).

abilities.description: Spore Cloud 2: On death, apply 2 turns of Vulnerable to the player.

intents.description: Bite: Deal 6 damage.
Grow: Gain 3 Strength.

behavior.description: First turn: 60% Bite, 40% Grow. After Grow, always uses Bite next turn. After two consecutive Bites, always uses Grow. Otherwise follows first-turn probabilities. Cannot use Bite three times in a row; cannot use Grow twice in a row.

abilities.description: Gold: On death, drops all stolen gold.

intents.description: Mug: Deal 10 damage and steal gold.
Lunge: Deal 12 damage and steal gold.
Smoke Bomb: Gain 6 Block.
Escape: Flee from combat, taking all stolen gold.

behavior.description: First two turns use Mug. On the third turn, 50% Lunge / 50% Smoke Bomb. After Lunge, next turn is always Smoke Bomb. After Smoke Bomb, next turn is Escape.

abilities.description: Rage 2: Whenever the player plays a Skill card, gain 2 Strength.

intents.description: Bellow: Gain 2 Rage.
Skull Bash: Deal 6 damage and apply 2 Vulnerable.
Bull Rush: Deal 14 damage.

after.description: Always uses Bellow on the first turn. Then randomly uses Skull Bash (33%) or Bull Rush (67%) each turn.

abilities.description: Metallicize 8: At the end of its turn, gain 8 Block.
Starts asleep. Wakes upon taking damage or on turn 4. If woken by damage, is stunned this turn. On waking, removes Metallicize.

intents.description: Heavy Strike: Deal 18 damage.
Siphon Soul: Player loses 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.

behavior.description: While asleep, Metallicize is active. Upon waking, follows Siphon Soul → Heavy Strike → Heavy Strike, repeating.

intents.description: Laser: Deal 9 damage.
Daze: Shuffle 2 Dazed cards into discard pile.

behavior.description: Three Sentries appear. One starts with Laser, two start with Daze. Each then alternates between Laser and Daze.

intents.description: Prepare: Ignite the six ghost flames.
Sear: Deal 6 damage and add 1 Burn to discard pile.
Double Strike: Deal 5 damage twice.
Inferno: Gain 2 Strength and 12 Block.
Hellfire: Deal 2 damage 6 times, add 3 Burn+ to discard pile.
Hellfire+: Deal X damage 6 times. X = (player's current HP / 12) + 1.

3_to_9.description: Starting from turn 3, follows a 7-turn cycle: Sear → Double Strike → Sear → Inferno → Double Strike → Sear → Hellfire.

behavior.description: Turn 1: Prepare. Turn 2: Hellfire+. Then begins the 7-turn cycle on turn 3.

abilities.description: Mode Shift 30 (Attack Mode only): After taking 30 damage while in Attack Mode, immediately enters Defensive Mode. Each subsequent shift increases the threshold by 10. This ability is inactive while in Defensive Mode.

intents.description: Charge Up: Gain 9 Block. Used on the first turn and after Whirlwind.
Fierce Bash: Deal 32 damage. Used after Charge Up.
Steam Spout: Apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable. Used after Fierce Bash.
Whirlwind: Deal 5 damage 4 times. Used after Steam Spout, or first turn after switching back to Attack Mode.
Strengthen: Gain 3 Sharp Hide. Used on the first turn after entering Defensive Mode.
Tackle: Deal 9 damage. Used on the second turn of Defensive Mode.
Double Slash: Deal 8 damage twice. After this, removes Sharp Hide, switches back to Attack Mode, and permanently increases Mode Shift threshold by 10.

behavior.description: Starts in Attack Mode. In Attack Mode, cycles: Charge Up → Fierce Bash → Steam Spout → Whirlwind → repeat. When the damage threshold is reached while in Attack Mode, immediately switches to Defensive Mode. In Defensive Mode: Strengthen (gain Sharp Hide 3) → Tackle → Double Slash. After Double Slash, removes Sharp Hide, switches back to Attack Mode, and permanently increases Mode Shift threshold by 10. Mode Shift only triggers in Attack Mode.

abilities.description: When HP ≤ 50%, forces next turn's intent to Split+.

intents.description: Goop Spray: Add 3 Slimed to discard pile.
Prepare: Does nothing.
Slam: Deal 35 damage.
Split+ into one Acid Slime (Large) and one Spike Slime (Large) with current HP.

behavior.description: Cycles: Goop Spray → Prepare → Slam. When HP ≤ 50%, forces Split+ on next turn.
